text: The Director, Finance and Administration, Toronto Public Health and the Director, Strategy and Preventive Health, Toronto Public Health will give a presentation on 2022 Toronto Public Health Operating Budget Request - Additional Information for Discussion.

The Board of Health - Budget Committee recommends that: 1. The Board of Health request the Medical Officer of Health to advocate to Health Canada and the Ontario Ministry of Health for funding for the six 2022 Budget Proposals below, as outlined in the presentation (October 5, 2021) from the Director, Finance and Administration, Toronto Public Health and the Medical Officer of Health, and to report to the December 6, 2021 meeting of the Board of Health on the progress made to secure funding: 1. enhance resources for the Toronto Drug Strategy Secretariat; 2. enhance programming for The Works; 3. an expanded Outreach Overdose Team; 4. expand Injectable Opioid Agonist Treatment (iOAT); 5. enhance data and improve data sharing; and 6.
